title: Health Systems
description: How health systems in OECD countries are organised, funded and reformed, compared side by side with their strengths and weaknesses.
assessment: Presentation of an assigned reading plus a final written exam with open questions (the exam is two thirds of the grade). Without the presentation, a longer exam counts 100%. No AI during the exam.
textbooks: Toth, F. (2021). Comparative Health Systems: A New Framework. Cambridge University Press.
